verdict.rationale: Metorial documents hosted MCP endpoints that a standard MCP client can point at without the developer deploying anything. Magic MCP servers give a hosted endpoint where Metorial manages the server and exposes the provider's tools through one connection [docs-34]. Sessions return a `connection_url` for any MCP client [docs-15], portals let users copy a standard MCP URL for clients like Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude [docs-29, docs-33], and Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and monitoring for catalog and custom servers [docs-23]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that an MCP client actually connects to a hosted URL and invokes downstream tools; the runtime probe only confirms the key-gated REST API.
